title: OpenClaw-PwnKit: Gets a reverse shell straight into almost any vulnerable OpenClaw host
description:
Giving AI bots terminal access through OpenClaw? You need to hear this. A 14-year-old just dropped OpenClaw-PwnKit. It’s a devastating exploit that gets a reverse shell straight into almost any vulnerable OpenClaw host! Yes, full control. If you’re running local AI agents without proper sandboxing, you are an easy target.  Sandbox your agents.

https://github.com/imbue-bit/OpenClaw-PwnKit
